name: guile-skills
description: Stand up and drive a Guile socket REPL from an agent: guile3 --debug --listen on a per-project port, a transcript-logging proxy on PORT+1, and the eval bridge that makes "verified" mean something. Use when starting or resuming a Guile/Scheme project, when a claim about Guile behaviour needs checking against a running interpreter, or when a REPL session should be recorded.
